recognize_zh: 視野中央一個帶狀至分葉核的嗜中性球，細胞質呈淡粉紅並散布細顆粒，但在核附近聚集一團粗大的深紫黑色顆粒；這種不均勻的黑色團塊與病史（碘造影劑注射後採血）提示嗜中性球吞噬的色素。
features: Single neutrophil with a curved band-to-segmented nucleus
Focal cluster of coarse dark purple-black granules near the nucleus
Remaining cytoplasm pale pink with finer granules extending to the cell margin
Background red cells with numerous echinocytes and occasional target-like cells
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil with a curved band-to-segmented nucleus and pale pink granular cytoplasm containing a focal cluster of coarse dark purple-black granules adjacent to the nucleus. The surrounding red cells include numerous echinocytes and a few target-like cells, with scattered platelets. No organisms or blasts are identified. In the context of blood sampled after iodinated contrast injection in a septic patient, findings are consistent with pigment inclusion in a neutrophil with accompanying toxic change.

ddx.vs: Toxic granules are dispersed throughout the cytoplasm rather than aggregated into a discrete black cluster.
Döhle bodies are pale blue-grey peripheral cytoplasmic patches, not dark granular clumps.
Features large blue spindle-shaped cytoplasmic inclusions with giant platelets and thrombocytopenia.
